title: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) — authoring aid
description: Curated subset of the JSON Schema 2020-12 vocabulary, used only to drive editor completion and hover when authoring CORE Elements. Not a validator-grade meta-schema: unknown keywords are permitted (additionalProperties defaults to true), so this never flags a valid schema as wrong.

$id.description: Identifier of this schema. For a CORE Element this is its CORE URN.

$ref.description: Reference to another schema, e.g. '#/$defs/Foo' or a CORE URN.

$comment.description: A comment for schema maintainers; ignored by validators.

type.description: The JSON type(s) a value must be.

enum.description: The value must equal one of these.

const.description: The value must equal this single constant.

required.description: Names of properties that must be present.

additionalProperties.description: Schema (or false) for properties not otherwise covered.

patternProperties.description: Schemas keyed by regular expressions matched against property names.

propertyNames.description: Schema every property name must satisfy.

prefixItems.description: Per-position schemas for the start of an array (tuple).

contains.description: At least one array item must match this schema.

uniqueItems.description: Whether array items must all differ.

pattern.description: Regular expression the string must match.

format.description: Semantic format annotation, e.g. date-time, date, time, email, uri, uuid, ipv4.

multipleOf.description: The value must be a multiple of this.

anyOf.description: At least one subschema must match.

not.description: The value must NOT match this subschema.

if.description: Conditional: when this matches, 'then' applies, otherwise 'else'.
